dt: Office-wide solicitation DARPA-PS-26-115 open through June 4, 2027
e: DARPA's renamed microsystems office seeks ideas not covered by its current programs: new device materials and components beyond CMOS, domestic fabrication tools and processes, and devices that use new physics, including hybrid electronic and non-electronic systems. Universities may propose; no citizenship limit is stated for proposers.
n: DARPA: Multi X Office (MXO, formerly MTO) Office-wide BAA
unv: Instrument type and award sizes not seen; full notice is on SAM.gov (DARPA-PS-26-115). The earlier MTO office-wide BAA HR001124S0028 is still listed on grants.gov.
